comments.value:
Oh yeah, that sounds convenient!
But I wouldn't be mad if the open beta released without this feature 😋

Personally, I like to not see the time while in VR. If that would be an option, I would like it to be toggleable. Or it could be visible in the options tab, and possibly pinnable similar to how the FPS and Ping is.

Most people have some kind of overlay nowadays but I think an ingame time would still be nice to have and easier to access (depending on the overlay).
I think it might even be a good idea to have it as an option next to the mic icon in the hud.
Please add a 24h option to. Not every country uses am/pm.
Also a seconds yes/no options. Seconds could be useful to time something ingame but aren't something you'd usually care about.

@{5f7ddd1db9104538486e51d6|full_name}: Thats the way i envision it it would be in the same place as the FPS and Ping and you could pin it so it would be visible on the the top of every menu screen if you so chose
The clock should also have an option to have a timezone independent "VRChat Time"
Seem it didnt make it in this time lets hope we do get this soon

This sounds like the perfect place to put it. Have it pinned at the top for easy access or hidden away if you don't want to see it.

I'd really like to see this implemented.

details: With the changes to the UI i think it should be time to add the local time to the menu. Next to the fps and ping and allow for it to be pinned just like the fps and ping. This will allow users to keep a closer eye on their time without having to use the horrible steam overlay.
title: [1137] [Feedback] Add the local time next to the fps
